summary: Tested Phase 1 simplification + customer Mini-Survey end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass — covers form posts (all 4 returning id with status=en_attente), public /api/demandes/{cat}/{id}/survey (saves source+feedback, no_change on empty, 404 invalid id, 400 invalid category), 3-status enforcement on PATCH (rejects invalid, maps legacy nouveau→en_attente, contacte/rdv_fixe→pris_en_charge, repare/annule→cloture), staff feedback PATCH (saves 3 fields, no_change empty, 404/400/401), stats new shape (en_attente/pris_en_charge/cloture; ca_total/reparations/panier_moyen REMOVED), all demands across collections have valid post-migration statuses, CSV export contains all 5 new columns (customer_source, customer_feedback, staff_source, staff_site_opinion, staff_dislikes). Frontend Playwright: Nîmes Costières phone is '07 57 53 23 89' (old '04 66 05 24 32' gone); Contact form → success page → MiniSurvey rendered with 5 source options (Google, Réseaux sociaux, Bouche à oreille, En passant devant le magasin, Autre) + feedback textarea + Submit/Skip buttons; Submit triggers real POST to /api/demandes/contact/{id}/survey with correct payload, then shows 'Merci pour votre retour !' thanks; Admin login works; no KPI banner / no CA fields anywhere; header shows '18 demandes · 16 en attente'; status dropdown has exactly the 3 expected options (En attente / Pris en charge / Closé); selecting Closé reveals StaffFeedbackForm with 3 textareas + Save button; saving persists and shows '✓ Enregistré'; expanded card shows 'Retour du client (mini-enquête)' section with the customer's source + feedback; mobile 375px has no horizontal overflow. Forms QuotePage/AppointmentPage/EnterprisePage/BuybackPage all integrate the same <MiniSurvey> via identical demandId+category pattern (verified via grep) and backend POST survey endpoint passes for all categories — tested via API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /demandes/{cat}/{id}/survey is public (no auth) by design — fine, but rate limiting/IP throttling is not present. Low priority since payload is bounded by Pydantic and only updates an existing UUID-keyed doc.

server.py update_staff_feedback uses {k: v for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None} — this means a client wishing to clear an existing field (e.g. set staff_dislikes back to '') cannot do so via this endpoint. If clearing is needed, allow empty strings explicitly.
server.py update_demand_ca remains exposed (admin only) even though the UI/CA flow was removed. Dead code — consider removing the endpoint and UpdateCARequest model to prevent stale CRUD surface.
AdminPage.jsx — the customer-survey section CSS uses uppercase styling on the heading; while purely cosmetic, the original wording 'Retour du client (mini-enquête)' is correctly preserved in the DOM.

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_-prefixed devis demands (TEST_Apple, TEST_StatusBrand, TEST_Survey, TEST_StatusPatch, TEST_Staff, TEST_CSV) plus TEST_-prefixed contact/b2b/buyback for form-post coverage. One devis (TEST_CSV) has both a customer survey (source=google, feedback=TEST_csv_fb) and staff feedback (TEST_csv_src/op/dis) populated — used to verify both 'Retour du client' UI section and CSV columns. One contact created via Playwright (TEST_PWUser) with customer survey filled (source=google, feedback=TEST_pw_feedback_xyz). One devis card was set to status=cloture and given staff feedback (TEST_pw_staff_source/opinion/dislikes) via Playwright. Total ~18 demands now in admin (16 en_attente, 2 cloture).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_survey.py covers the new Phase-1 surface comprehensively (auth, public survey, status patch + legacy mapping, staff feedback, stats new shape, list status sanity, CSV columns). Old /app/backend/tests/test_admin_crm.py is now OUTDATED (asserts ca_total/reparations/panier_moyen which were removed and uses 'contacte' status that's now mapped) — DO NOT run it; reuse test_phase1_survey.py for regression. The migration on startup converted all legacy statuses to en_attente/pris_en_charge/cloture; verified via TestDemandesList. MiniSurvey is the same shared component used across QuotePage/ContactPage/AppointmentPage/EnterprisePage/BuybackPage with identical props pattern; only Contact path was manually walked through Playwright (others equivalent + backend endpoint covers all 4 categories). data-testids of interest: mini-survey, survey-source, survey-feedback, survey-submit, survey-skip, mini-survey-thanks, customer-survey-{id}, survey-badge-{id}, staff-feedback-{id}, staff-source-{id}, staff-opinion-{id}, staff-dislikes-{id}, staff-save-{id}, staff-saved-{id}, demand-status-select-{id}, admin-total-count.
